protocol.name: river_workspace_v1

description.summary: let the window manager publish its workspaces

protocol.description:
This protocol allows the river-window-management-v1 window manager to tell the compositor about its workspaces. The compositor shows them to other clients, for example through ext-workspace-v1, and passes their requests to activate a workspace back to the window manager.
The compositor does not know what a workspace holds and does not change what is rendered on its own, the window manager stays in charge.

interface.name: river_workspace_manager_v1
interface.description: This global interface should only be advertised to the client if the river_window_manager_v1 global is also advertised.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request indicates that the client will no longer use the river_workspace_manager_v1 object. Workspaces created through it are not affected.

request.name: get_workspace

description.summary: create a workspace on an output

request.description:
Create a new workspace on the given output. The window manager should set its name and state right after creating it.
If the output has been removed, the workspace is inert: it is never shown and never receives events.

interface.name: river_workspace_v1

description.summary: a workspace of the window manager

interface.description: The requests of this interface may be made at any time, they are not tied to manage or render sequences. The compositor forwards the changes to other clients batched.

entry.name: active
entry.summary: the workspace is shown on its output

entry.name: hidden
entry.summary: the workspace should not be listed, for example because it is empty

request.name: destroy
request.description: Remove the workspace. Other clients are told that it is gone.

request.name: set_name

description.summary: set the name of the workspace

request.description: Set the name shown to other clients, for example "1".

request.name: set_position

description.summary: set the position of the workspace

request.description: Set the place of the workspace among the workspaces of its output, lower comes first. Other clients use it to sort the workspaces. The initial position is 0.

request.name: set_state

description.summary: set the state of the workspace

request.description: Replace the state of the workspace. The initial state is empty.

event.name: activate

description.summary: a client asked to show the workspace

event.description: Another client asked for this workspace to be shown on its output. The window manager decides whether and when it does so, and reports the result with set_state.
